title: Visited Work Tape Cells Under Seam Composition
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with $k$ work tapes and Boolean input $x$, with states in $S_1$ and $S_2$, respectively. Suppose that starting $M_1$ in state $start$ with work-tape words $w_0$ reaches state $exit$ with words $w_1$ after $T_1$ steps, and that $M_1$ is not in state $exit$ at any earlier time $t<T_1$. Suppose also that starting $M_2$ in state $entry$ with words $w_1$ reaches state $q_2$ with words $w_2$ after $T_2$ steps. Then, for every work tape $i$, the cells visited by its head in the seam-composed machine through time $T_1+1+T_2$ are contained in the union of the cells visited by that tape in the first computation through time $T_1$ and in the second computation through time $T_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The first run reaches the configuration with state $exit$ and words $w_1$ at time $T_1$
The first run avoids state $exit$ at every time $t<T_1$
The second run from state $entry$ with words $w_1$ reaches state $q_2$ with words $w_2$ at time $T_2$
